title: 十二支の線画（ぬりえ）
subject_en: Black and white coloring-page line art of the twelve zodiac animals, each ONE animal separate, big, simple, clean closed outlines, no shading, white interior. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 子から亥までの十二支の動物を、はっきりした線で描いた12点のぬりえ素材です。年賀状の下絵や、家庭・教室のぬりえに使えます。
items: a sitting mouse with a round tail
a sitting rabbit with long ears
a friendly long dragon curling in the air
a coiled snake with a simple pattern
a galloping horse with a mane
a sheep with curly wool standing
a monkey sitting and holding a peach
a rooster crowing with a big tail
a sitting dog with a wagging tail
